# O5 · Outdoors {.unnumbered}

The station leaves the desk: it goes into its shelter, in the garden, and starts the data collection. This chapter switches it on and checks that it works.

## Before switching on

The data collection starts with an empty database on the server, without the rows of the bench tests. One command empties it, after asking for a confirmation; the old database and the old log stay on the server, with the suffix `.before-reset`:

```bash
pixi run reset-backend
```

## Switching on

The station is switched on in the garden, with the switch of the Grove Shield, before the lid is closed. At its first wake-up, the station measures, uploads at once, and sets its clock with NTP. Then it measures every 15 minutes and uploads every hour.

Two checks tell that everything works:

- **the dashboard** shows the first measurement, a few seconds after the switch;
- **the maintenance button**, pressed under the shelter, starts the maintenance mode: the phone finds the access point of the station and opens its page, which shows the measurements stored.

The log of the station, on the server (`station.log`), shows both, as on the first morning of our station (28 October 2026, times in UTC):

```text
=== 2026-10-28T08:00:28Z ===
PAWS firmware v0.9.0-36-g56fd949-dirty on XIAO ESP32-S3
-> BOOT
-> MEASURE
-> STORE
   stored: 2026-10-28T08:00:28Z,1,21.25,54.82,1011.27
-> UPLOAD
   Wi-Fi connected in 2000 ms
   sent 106 bytes of measurements, server answered 200 {"received":1,"inserted":1,"duplicates":0}
   sent 496 bytes of log, server answered 200 {"received":18}
-> TIME_SYNC
   NTP time received
   clock set to 08:00:34
-> SCHEDULE
   alarm set for 08:15:00
-> SLEEP
   awake for 3476 ms

=== 2026-10-28T08:03:43Z ===
PAWS firmware v0.9.0-36-g56fd949-dirty on XIAO ESP32-S3
-> BOOT
-> MAINTENANCE
   access point "PAWS-maintenance" started, page: http://192.168.4.1
   access point stopped
-> MEASURE
...
```

From 08:15, the wake-ups follow the alarm of the clock, every 15 minutes, and last less than half a second when the station does not upload.

## Next Steps

The station collects data. The next firmware steps add the battery monitor, the INA219.
